hook.en: In 2017 the WannaCry attack locked the files of hospitals, banks and offices in about 150 countries within a few days. Programs written to cause harm are called malware, and today we meet the main kinds.
hook.kn: 2017 ರಲ್ಲಿ WannaCry ದಾಳಿ ಕೆಲವೇ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 150 ದೇಶಗಳ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್, ಕಚೇರಿಗಳ ಕಡತಗಳನ್ನು ಬಂದ್ ಮಾಡಿತು. ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಲು ಬರೆದ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂಗಳೇ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್.

objectives.en: Define malware and threats to security
Tell virus, worm, ransomware and Trojan apart

narration.en: In 2017 the WannaCry attack locked the files of hospitals, banks and offices in about 150 countries within a few days. Programs written to cause harm are called malware, and today we meet the main kinds.
narration.kn: 2017 ರಲ್ಲಿ WannaCry ದಾಳಿ ಕೆಲವೇ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು 150 ದೇಶಗಳ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆ, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್, ಕಚೇರಿಗಳ ಕಡತಗಳನ್ನು ಬಂದ್ ಮಾಡಿತು. ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಲು ಬರೆದ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂಗಳೇ ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್.

body.en: Any risk that can harm a computer system or its data, such as theft, damage or unauthorised access, is a security threat. Malware (malicious software) is software written to disrupt or damage a computer, steal data, or gain unauthorised access. A virus is a piece of code that attaches itself to a host program or file and spreads when that file is executed or shared; it can corrupt files and slow the system. A worm is a standalone, self-replicating program that spreads across networks on its own, without a host file.

points.en: Virus: needs a host file; activated when it runs
Worm: standalone; replicates over the network

narration.kn: ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಎಂದರೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಲು ಅಥವಾ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಕದಿಯಲು ಬರೆದ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ. ವೈರಸ್ ಆತಿಥೇಯ ಕಡತಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಟಿಕೊಂಡು ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ; ವರ್ಮ್ ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರವಾಗಿ ಜಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನನ್ನು ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: Four kinds of malware

say.en: Let us make a quick comparison table of four malware types.
A virus hides inside a host file and copies itself when that file runs.
A worm needs no host. It sends copies of itself across the network on its own.
A Trojan pretends to be useful but does not copy itself. Ransomware locks your data for money.
Picture how a worm spreads: one infected computer infects two, they infect four, and so on.

narration.en: We build a comparison table and then sketch how a worm spreads.

body.en: Ransomware blocks the user’s access to data, usually by encrypting the files, and demands a ransom (often in cryptocurrency) to restore access; WannaCry in 2017 is a famous example. A Trojan, named after the wooden horse of Troy, looks like a legitimate and useful program but carries hidden malicious code; it may open a back door for an attacker. Trojans do not replicate themselves; they spread when users install them.

narration.kn: ರ್ಯಾನ್ಸಮ್‌ವೇರ್ ಕಡತಗಳನ್ನು ಗೂಢಲಿಪೀಕರಿಸಿ ಹಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಟ್ರೋಜನ್ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂನಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಒಳಗೆ ಹಾನಿಕಾರಕ ಸಂಕೇತ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದು ತನ್ನನ್ನು ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

title.en: How fast does a worm spread?

caption.en: Suppose every infected computer infects r new computers each hour. After t hours (1 + r) to the power t computers are infected. This is why worms can cripple networks in hours.

label.en: New infections per infected computer per hour

tryThis.en: With r = 1, how many hours until more than 1000 computers are infected?
Change r to 2. How much sooner is the 1000 mark crossed?
Why does disconnecting an infected computer from the network help so much?

narration.en: Suppose every infected computer infects r new computers each hour. After t hours (1 + r) to the power t computers are infected. This is why worms can cripple networks in hours. With r = 1, how many hours until more than 1000 computers are infected?

body.en: Virus = Visitor: it lives inside a host file. Worm = Wanders by itself over the network. Trojan = Trick: a gift with soldiers inside. Ransomware = Ransom note.

narration.en: Virus needs a host, the worm wanders, the Trojan tricks, and ransomware leaves a ransom note.

problem.en: Classify each incident: (a) A free "speed booster" app installs and secretly lets a stranger control the PC. (b) Files on a laptop become unreadable and a message demands ₹20,000. (c) A college network slows down as a program copies itself from machine to machine. (d) A macro inside a shared document infects other documents when opened.

steps.en: (a) Disguised as useful software, opens a back door → Trojan
(c) Self-replicating across the network without a host → Worm
(d) Attached to a host document, spreads when it is opened → Virus

narration.en: Ask two questions each time: does it need a host, and does it copy itself?
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

A Trojan pretends to be useful and does not replicate.

homework.en: Find out about one real malware attack (for example WannaCry or ILOVEYOU): what type was it, how did it spread, and what damage did it do?

narration.en: Recap. Malware is software written to damage, disrupt or steal. A virus needs a host file; a worm spreads on its own. Ransomware encrypts data and demands payment. A Trojan pretends to be useful and does not replicate.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. ಮಾಲ್‌ವೇರ್ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಲು ಅಥವಾ ಕದಿಯಲು ಬರೆದ ತಂತ್ರಾಂಶ. ವೈರಸ್‌ಗೆ ಆತಿಥೇಯ ಕಡತ ಬೇಕು; ವರ್ಮ್ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ. ರ್ಯಾನ್ಸಮ್‌ವೇರ್ ದತ್ತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ಗೂಢಲಿಪೀಕರಿಸಿ ಹಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಟ್ರೋಜನ್ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತದಂತೆ ನಟಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನಕಲು ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
